title.zh: 【加密做市商 GSR 承诺投入 1 亿美元布局链上信贷业务 Hare】
title.en: 【加密做市商 GSR 承诺投入 1 亿美元布局链上信贷业务 Hare】

current_state.zh: Crypto trading and market-making firm GSR will deploy $100 million in credit lines to anchor Hare, a new on-chain credit venture built with liquidity distribution platform Turtle, launching two Aave-based vault products — Hare USD Earn for major dollar stablecoins and Hare Gold Earn for Paxos tokenized gold (PAXG/PAXGy).
